channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.description: (Updated 9-22-2026: Added a note indicating the September 2026 non-security preview update is the final preview update for Windows 11, version 24H2.) The September 2026 non-security preview update is now available for Windows 11, versions 26H1, 25H2, and 24H2. Information about the contents of this update is available in the release notes, which are accessible from the Windows 11 update history page. item.title: MC1447682: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced live captions settings and right-side panel view
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing live captions with a new right-side panel view and a consolidated settings menu for easier configuration. Users can auto-enable captions, submit feedback, and benefit from synchronized translation settings. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, completing worldwide by October 2026, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1443520: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in meetings and webinars
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a default meeting option allowing organizers to specify who controls production tools in meetings and webinars, improving event management by assigning production roles separately from presenters. Rollout starts mid-August 2026, completing by October 2026, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1429012: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing call delegation with a new "Lock an Ongoing Call" feature to restrict delegate participation and an optional warning tone notifying when a delegate joins or resumes a call. These updates improve privacy and transparency during delegated calls, rolling out globally from August to October 2026.

item.title: MC1332816: Scoped SharePoint search in Teams (SharePoint app, also called Viva Connections)
item.description: Starting end of June 2026, Teams' SharePoint app (Viva Connections) search will scope results to SharePoint content, showing suggestions in Teams and opening results in SharePoint. The feature is default-enabled, respects permissions, requires no admin changes, and aims to improve search relevance within Teams.

item.title: MC1324280: Assign open shifts in Microsoft Teams Shifts
item.description: Microsoft Teams Shifts introduces "Assign open shifts," enabling managers to automatically assign open shifts based on availability, time off, historical patterns, and rules. Rolling out worldwide from mid-June to October 2026, the feature is optional, reviewable before publishing, and controlled by existing scheduling permissions.

item.title: MC1317836: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to send messages while files upload asynchronously in the background, improving real-time collaboration. This update, rolling out from August to October 2026, affects all platforms and requires no action. Compliance and file-sharing policies remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1316231: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Webinars and structured meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will default front-of-room displays to attendee view during webinars and structured meetings starting mid-June 2026, enhancing in-room participant experience. Presenters keep full control via console. The feature requires a Teams Rooms Pro license, is enabled by default, and needs no user action.

item.title: MC1323270: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, alongside existing RTMP. SRT offers improved reliability with backup streams and automatic failover. IT admins must enable SRT via policy. No impact on attendees; existing workflows remain supported.

item.title: MC1251206: Microsoft Teams: Identify external bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect and label external meeting assistant bots joining meetings, giving organizers control to approve, deny, or remove them. A new admin policy will manage bot handling. Rollout begins mid-May 2026, completing by October 2026, enhancing meeting security and compliance.

item.title: MC1257308: Microsoft Teams: Building‑level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: Microsoft is adding building-level insights to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal's recommended actions page, highlighting buildings with high Teams Rooms usage and BYOD rooms to improve consistency. This feature, enabled by default for eligible licenses, will roll out from mid-June to October 2026 worldwide. No action is required.

item.title: MC1472252: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Enable on-account category in Dataverse
item.description: We are announcing the ability to sync transaction categories for retainers and milestones between Microsoft Dataverse and Dynamics 365 in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables categorization of retainers, milestones, and advances for accurate revenue posting in Dynamics 365 Finance. This feature will introduce the following capabilities:Expose Transaction Category field: This adds a Transaction...

item.title: MC1261595: Microsoft Teams town halls now support backup Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams
item.description: Microsoft Teams town halls will support backup RTMP streams to improve live event reliability, automatically switching to a secondary stream if the primary fails. This feature, available by default with no admin setup needed, rolls out worldwide from late April to October 2026, affecting organizers using RTMP workflows.

item.title: MC1256307: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
item.description: Microsoft Teams will sync recently used emojis and reactions across all devices by late July 2026 (general availability). The feature is enabled by default, requires no user action, and maintains existing admin settings without impacting data flow or compliance. Admins may update documentation or inform support teams.

item.title: MC1045221: Microsoft Teams: New user setting to view incoming calls in a small window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new default setting allowing users to view incoming calls in a small, resizable window to reduce disruption. The feature will roll out from May 2025 to October 2026 across all platforms, requiring no admin action but user notification is recommended.

item.title: MC1472191: Power Automate - Create and manage custom dashboard tiles
item.description: Update: Release of this feature has been postponed; we will announce a new date in the future. We are announcing the ability to create and manage custom dashboard tiles in Power Automate. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables users to monitor the metrics that matter most to their role or team without relying on external tools. By allowing personalized visualizations directly within Automation Center, users can gain faster insi...

item.title: MC1438571: Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
item.description: Microsoft 365 will change the default visibility of 11 profile card properties to display by default when populated, starting late October 2026. Administrators can review and hide specific properties using Microsoft Graph APIs before rollout. Visibility management remains available via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1269864: Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. Rollout starts mid-October 2026, completing by mid-November. Users can enable, disable, and reorder these sections; no admin action is required.

item.title: RM503772: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
item.description: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.

item.title: RM557563: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
item.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

item.title: RM558437: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention– Unmanaged cloud app discovery and protection with Microsoft Purview and the Island Enterprise Browser
item.description: Microsoft Purview network data security now integrates with Island, extending protection to Island’s browser-based workflows at the point of user interaction. With this integration, new and existing Island customers can configure Microsoft Purview collection and data loss prevention policies to detect and protect data shared with unmanaged cloud apps through the Island Enterprise Browser, the Island Extension, and browser add ins via HTTP and HTTPS, using the same classifiers, sensitive informat...

item.title: RM558933: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
item.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

item.title: RM560076: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
item.description: This feature empowers authors to create rich, interactive charts with AI in SharePoint when editing SharePoint pages. Authors can describe the chart they want to create in plain language within a chat on a SharePoint page.

item.title: RM560822: SharePoint: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
item.description: Recipient groups in eSignature allow a recipient slot to be assigned to multiple people, such that any one of those people can fulfil the signing requirement on behalf of the group.

item.title: RM562017: Microsoft Viva: Fresh Copilot Metrics in Custom Person Queries & Reports- Viva Advanced Analysis
item.description: Key Microsoft 365 Copilot metrics in custom person queries and reports will have values up to 2-3 days old from the current date. This will provide fresher copilot usage analysis to analysts in Viva Advanced analysis.

item.title: RM562343: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
item.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

item.title: RM559017: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay‑As‑You‑Go usage
item.description: Enables metered, pay‑as‑you‑go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre‑assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.

item.title: RM565222: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description: Self-service diagnostics help identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The experience highlights potential misconfigurations and provides simple guidance to help customers understand and resolve them. This brings basic troubleshooting into the product and helps eDiscovery admins overcome common challenges.

item.title: RM566527: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
item.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

item.title: RM571192: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Support Not Applicable answer option for quality evaluation criteria
item.description: Criteria questions now support a Not Applicable answer option. When a question is marked as not applicable, it is excluded from scoring instead of negatively affecting the evaluation score. This helps ensure evaluations remain accurate when a specific criterion does not apply to the case, interaction, or business scenario being reviewed.

item.title: RM569019: Microsoft Teams: Identify custom apps that need updates for Teams private and shared channels
item.description: Admins will be able to view in Teams Admin Center a list of custom apps in their tenant that need to be updated to work in private and shared channels. This experience will help admins identify impacted apps, understand which apps require developer action, and coordinate updates so users can continue using custom apps across all supported channel types.

item.title: RM569207: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

item.title: RM570846: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
item.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

item.title: RM571387: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
item.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter or any participant’s video into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

item.title: RM571390: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

item.title: RM570446: Microsoft Viva: Ability for leaders to publish Power BI reports
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is extending its report publishing capabilities from analysts to leader personas such as Chief Officers, Managers and their delegates. This enhancement enables leaders to directly distribute curated reports within their organizations through a lightweight publishing experience, complementing the existing report customization features.

item.title: RM571191: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Detailed quality evaluation score breakdown
item.description: Evaluation details now include a scoring breakdown at the overall, section, and question level. Users can see how the final evaluation score was calculated, including how individual question outcomes contribute to section scores and the overall score. This improves transparency, helps quality teams validate results, and makes it easier to identify areas for coaching, calibration, and process improvement.

item.title: RM503553: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Authoritative content management for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
item.description: Specify and manage SharePoint sites deemed as authoritative content to enhance their relevance and ranking in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, under Copilot > Search > Authoritative content, add and manage up to 100 SharePoint sites. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM571193: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Inactivate quality evaluation records
item.description: Quality managers can now inactivate evaluation records that should no longer contribute to scoring or reporting. Inactive evaluations are preserved for traceability but excluded from overall score calculations and analytics. This helps teams correct reporting outcomes when evaluations were created in error, used the wrong criteria, were duplicates, or should otherwise be removed from active quality results.

item.title: RM571302: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports knowledge source in criteria
item.description: Criteria questions can now use knowledge sources to help evaluate customer interactions. This allows organizations to ground evaluation criteria in approved knowledge content, policies, or guidance so quality checks can better reflect expected handling standards. This preview capability is scoped to case and on-demand evaluations.

item.title: RM568782: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
item.description: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

item.title: RM571879: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
item.description: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings gives organizations greater control over access to sensitive meetings. Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.

item.title: RM571886: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local inferencing
item.description: Local inferencing expands Microsoft Copilot’s sovereign controls by enabling AI inferencing for supported Copilot interactions to occur within the applicable local geography.

item.title: MC1476322: Customized PowerBI reports behavior after major report updates
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights customized Power BI reports will remain tied to their original report versions and won’t auto-update with major report changes. Users must create new customized reports from the latest versions to access updated data and features. No admin action or policy changes are needed.

item.title: MC1476319: Microsoft SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will shift AI-assisted FAQ creation to Copilot in SharePoint, while retaining manual FAQ editing in the web part. Rollout starts late October 2026. Existing content remains unchanged, requiring no migration. No admin action needed; inform authors and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1476237: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Remediation actions from the Teams message entity flyout
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enhance the Teams message entity flyout by late September 2026, enabling security admins to submit messages to Microsoft and block senders or domains in one workflow. This streamlines Teams message investigations for Plan 1 and Plan 2 customers without requiring configuration changes.

item.title: MC1476008: Dynamics 365 Field Service – Automate optimizations with Scheduling Operations Agent (Preview)
item.description: We are announcing the ability to automatically schedule and run recurring optimizations through the Scheduling Operations Agent in Dynamics 365 Field Service. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? item.title: MC1454113: Microsoft Copilot Word: Document summarization experience moving
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft Word's document summarization will move from the Top of Doc experience to other Copilot surfaces, maintaining AI-powered summaries accessible via Copilot prompts. No admin action is needed, but user communication and training updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1421920: Surveys agent retirement and transition to Copilot in Microsoft Forms
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Surveys agent by August 31, 2026, transitioning users to a unified Copilot-powered experience within Microsoft Forms. Existing users lose access by December 2026. No licensing changes are needed; workflows continue seamlessly with enhanced AI features. Users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1290821: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
item.description: Microsoft 365 eSignature introduces recipient groups, allowing up to 10 people per recipient slot, with the first signer fulfilling the requirement. This reduces delays in signature workflows. Public preview ends late September 2026; general availability runs December 2026. No admin action needed; feature respects existing policies.

item.title: MC1429018: Microsoft Teams: AI meeting archive file generation
item.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting archive files starting early November 2026 to improve Copilot and Facilitator responses while ensuring privacy. Archives are stored in tenant-owned SharePoint, accessible only to meeting participants, and governed by configurable retention policies. Admin controls will be available before rollout.

item.title: MC1462915: Allow connections to copilot.cloud.microsoft before the Copilot URL redirect
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. Organizations must ensure network and security controls allow connections to *.cloud.microsoft to avoid Copilot access disruptions across web, desktop, and Edge apps. Validate connectivity and update allow lists before October.

item.title: MC1475801: Dynamics 365 Contact Center – Enable AI-assisted time-off and swap requests
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable AI-assisted time-off and swap requests in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 1, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables an AI-assisted solution that provides automation for workforce schedules and approvals, governance across time‑off requests, shift bidding, and shift swapping. Supervisor oversight is supported throughout, along with configurable approval rules, and agent-driven decisions with...

item.title: MC1474455: In-app browsing in Copilot app
item.description: The Microsoft Copilot app now supports in-app browsing on Windows and Mac, allowing users to open websites side-by-side with chat. Administrators can opt-in selected devices to test this feature, manage policies, and prepare support. Browsing data is stored locally, and users can open links externally if desired.

item.title: MC1475456: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Perform bulk operations for bookings on schedule board
item.description: We are announcing the ability to move or reassign multiple bookings at once, directly from the schedule board in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature eliminates repetitive, manual edits required during common scenarios such as resource replacement, timeline shifts, scope changes, or schedule realignments. The feature significantly reduces administrative effort and helps you respond quickly to change a...

item.title: MC1474458: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now support adding Power BI reports as references, enhancing summaries with real business data. Public preview starts late September 2026; general availability begins late October 2026. No extra setup is needed if Power BI and Copilot are already enabled. Organizations without Power BI see no change.

item.title: MC1422063: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
item.description: OneDrive for Business on Windows will improve sync error messages for paths exceeding 520 characters, guiding users to rename or move files without stopping sync. This update, rolling out October 2026, reduces confusion and support tickets with clearer, actionable guidance and no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1249424: Microsoft Purview DLP: Unmanaged cloud app protection with Microsoft Purview and the Island Enterprise Browser
item.description: Microsoft Purview now integrates with the Island Enterprise Browser to extend data loss prevention and network data security to browser-based workflows. Available from late March 2026 (preview) and June 2027 (general availability), admins must enable this feature to inspect and protect data shared via Island-managed browsers using existing Purview policies.

item.title: RM571847: Dynamics 365 Finance: Core finance - Improve financial journal processing and control
item.description: Finance teams rely on journals for high-volume accounting processes, where performance, accuracy, and visibility are critical to keeping financial operations moving. The new financial journal capabilities in Dynamics 365 Finance will provide a more scalable approach to creating, importing, reviewing, and posting journals, helping finance teams reduce manual steps and identify issues earlier in the process.

item.title: RM571637: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork for Government Clouds
item.description: Copilot Cowork makes it easy to delegate work. Describe the outcome you want and Cowork automatically grounds the work in your emails, meetings, messages, files, and data.

item.title: RM571392: Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity
item.description: Planner plans created from Teams meetings (via Meeting Notes or Loop) often remain unused long after the meeting ends. These inactive plans accumulate and clutter over time. This feature automatically expires and deletes meeting-created plans that have had no task activity for 180 days. Only the Planner plan is removed whereas the tasks in Loop and meeting notes stay intact.

item.title: RM570844: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
item.description: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.

item.title: RM571306: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
item.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

item.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. item.title: RM571307: Microsoft Edge: Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices
item.description: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts. Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

item.title: RM566351: PowerPoint: Create on brand presentations with additional brand assets
item.description: Seamlessly access your brand colors, images, icons, logos and more right within PowerPoint to create on-brand presentations.

item.title: RM562993: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention — Endpoint DLP now supports a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition
item.description: Endpoint DLP now includes a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition. Previously, file extensions were entered as free form text, which could result in unsupported or non-scannable extensions being used. This could lead to gaps in protection and increase processing overhead on endpoints. With the pre curated list, you can select only supported file extensions. This helps improve policy reliability and reduces unnecessary processing on endpoints.

item.title: RM561322: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in PowerPoint for Government clouds
item.description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot uses your files, meetings, emails, and more to help shape content and iterate quickly, and it connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, in...

item.title: RM500638: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat - Session Persistence Enhancement
item.description: This feature ensures that conversations are preserved even when users navigate away from a session. As soon as a prompt is submitted, an entry is immediately created in the navigation pane’s session history. This allows users to leave the session and return later just as if they had never left. The update enhances continuity and reliability, making it easier to navigate without losing progress. Updated September 18, 2026: We are cancelling this Roadmap item at this time. item.title: RM500242: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent recap for DoD
item.description: Intelligent meeting recap uses AI to provide a quick summary of your meeting, highlighting key discussion points, identifying follow-up actions, and offering quick access to significant points such as name mentions, when a screen was shared, individualized speaker markers, topics, and chapters.

item.title: RM496596: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Content Sources in Copilot Chat
item.description: Users will able to select content sources on Copilot Chat. When users select content sources the responses generated will be limited to content from the selected sources. Updated September 18, 2026: We are cancelling this Roadmap item at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM487852: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
item.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

item.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. item.title: MC1473153: Microsoft Teams: New centralized experience for organizing important resources in chats and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a centralized resource management experience in chats and channels, allowing users to pin and organize resources below headers and access them on mobile. The "In this chat" and "In this channel" panes will be removed. Rollout begins late September 2026; no admin action required.

item.title: MC1384415: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now supports a pre‑curated file extension list
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now uses a pre-curated list of supported, scannable file extensions for policy configuration, improving accuracy and enforcement consistency. Free-form file extension entry is removed. Rollout starts mid-December 2026. Existing policies remain unchanged unless edited, requiring unsupported extensions to be removed.

item.title: MC1469960: Microsoft Exchange Online: Review and configure EWSAllowedAppIDs before Exchange Web Services access changes
item.description: Microsoft is updating how EWSAllowedAppIDs is applied in Exchange Online as part of EWS retirement starting October 1, 2026. Organizations using EWS must review and configure their EWSAllowedAppIDs list to avoid service disruption. Microsoft may generate a list if none exists but won’t overwrite tenant-configured lists.

item.title: MC1474111: Retirement of Microsoft 365 Companion apps
item.description: Microsoft 365 companion apps (Calendar, People, Files) will retire on December 16, 2026, ceasing support and functionality. Admins must stop new installations and remove existing apps. Core Microsoft 365 features remain unaffected, accessible via Outlook, Teams, and other tools. Users should be informed and guided accordingly.

item.title: MC1474110: Microsoft Planner: Capacity view
item.description: Capacity view in Microsoft Planner, launching October 2026, shows a live staffing timeline from existing task data for Plan 3 users on web/desktop (Teams, Outlook). It helps spot workload distribution without extra reports. No admin action needed; keep task details updated for accuracy.

item.title: MC1474107: Microsoft Purview: Archive file classification behavior change for Endpoint Data Loss Prevention on Windows endpoints
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP on Windows will classify archive files (.zip, .rar) as single atomic objects, reporting only the outer archive in events. This change, rolling out from September to November 2026, improves consistency and performance without requiring user or admin action.

item.title: MC1474106: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Microsoft Teams messages
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 introduces a new MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Teams messages, enabling authorized security analysts to query message snippets and metadata for threat investigations. It rolls out worldwide from late September to mid-October 2026, requiring appropriate permissions for access.

item.title: MC1474104: Microsoft Entra ID: Follow-up on SMS first-factor sign-in retirement and upcoming changes
item.description: Microsoft is retiring SMS first-factor sign-in for Microsoft Entra ID workforce tenants worldwide starting February 1, 2027, to enhance security. Organizations must identify affected users, migrate them to phishing-resistant methods like passkeys, and update policies to avoid sign-in disruptions and comply with new requirements.

item.title: RM570441: Outlook: Multi Account Search
item.description: Users will be able to see results from multiple mailboxes interweaved in a single ranked list and will be able to do standard mail actions.

item.title: RM570863: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Book Work Orders with Multiple Requirements
item.description: Dispatchers can now select which resource requirement to schedule when booking a work order that has multiple requirements. The new Book experience is available from both the work order form and list view, and shows relevant details such as requirement duration, time windows, resource preferences, booking status, and links to active bookings.

item.title: RM571298: Microsoft Teams: Customize blocked file extensions for Weaponizable File Protection
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding admin controls for Weaponizable File Protection. Administrators will be able to customize which file types are blocked in Teams to align with their organization's security requirements or continue using the Microsoft-recommended default list. This added flexibility helps organizations tailor file protection policies while maintaining a secure collaboration environment.

item.title: RM570427: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files

item.title: MC1430536: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Unified alert queue

item.description: Copilot for Security in DLP can summarize DLP policies. This enhancement enables DLP admins to gain insights on coverage of policies viz. location, classifiers and notifications, and more.

item.title: RM543713: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

item.title: RM486828: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Apply a retention policy to Microsoft Planner content
item.description: Introducing Data lifecycle management capabilities for Microsoft Planner. Compliance admins can now create a retention policy to manage content located in Microsoft Planner such as tasks for plans associated with an Microsoft 365 Group.

item.title: RM561490: Microsoft Teams: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. However, when teams use meetings as their primary collaboration surface for long-running initiatives, tasks from the same project can become scattered across multiple auto-generated plans. With this capability, users can now connect Teams meetings to existing Planner plans, so all related tasks across meetings can be tracked in one place.

item.title: RM561857: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Topic Assignments Included in Comment Report Export
item.description: When exporting comments to spreadsheet from the Comments report, the topic(s) assigned to each comment will be included in the export.

item.title: RM570647: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

item.title: RM570440: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
item.description: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.

item.title: RM569447: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

item.title: RM568364: Microsoft Viva: Rolling out Custom branding in Engage
item.description: Engage is rolling out Custom Branding, a new admin-led capability that lets organizations define a customized, tenant-wide visual identity across the Engage web and mobile apps. Engage-level admins can configure a brand name, add large and small logos, and a theme color that is applied consistently for all users in the tenant. Branding is managed from the new Brand Center in the Viva Engage admin center and helps organizations reinforce their identity throughout the Engage experience.

item.title: RM567895: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
item.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

item.title: RM567671: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
item.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

item.title: RM522616: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
item.description: Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt so you can edit before you send. It’s a faster, more controlled way to get help right where you’re working.

item.title: RM561204: Planner: My Tasks redesign
item.description: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

item.title: RM476488: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
item.description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

item.description: Microsoft is updating the sender email for Copilot-related educational and enablement emails to microsoftcopilotupdates@microsoft.com by mid-September 2026. item.title: MC1469961: Microsoft Viva Glint: Copilot features are no longer available for cross-tenant guest users
item.description: Starting August 26, 2026, Microsoft Viva Glint's Copilot features will be unavailable to Microsoft Entra cross-tenant guest users due to underlying service limitations. Affected users will no longer see Copilot functionalities, but other Viva Glint features remain unchanged. No admin action or Copilot license assignment will restore access.

item.title: MC1466751: Microsoft Teams: Lobby visibility will align with the "Who can admit from lobby" meeting option
item.description: Starting early September 2026, Microsoft Teams will align lobby visibility with the "Who can admit from lobby" setting, so only those allowed to admit participants can see the lobby. This change improves privacy, is automatic, and may affect meeting workflows involving presenters monitoring the lobby.

item.title: RM499153: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enhanced personalization with memory in Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will improve memory in Copilot by increasing the relevance and quality of Copilot responses based on previous communications. This AI-powered capability improves the relevance and quality of Copilot responses by learning from previous communications. These memories are private to the user.

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, providing easier access and AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins late September 2026 worldwide, with no license or admin changes. No action is required, but communication and documentation updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1446797: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will receive a modernized Gallery view starting mid-August 2026, aligning with Windows experience by improving participant visibility, consistent layouts, and meeting display controls. Admins can configure settings; no action is required before rollout. Audio participants will be deprioritized when video is prioritized.

item.title: MC1443518: Microsoft Teams: Expanded presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing presenter visibility in "Manage what attendees see" by allowing event organizers and producers to drag and resize the presenter panel, showing more presenters simultaneously. This improves monitoring, transitions, and management of large events, rolling out from mid-August to late September 2026. No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1462473: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
item.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes for presenters starting September 2026. This update enhances flexibility, accessibility, and personalization without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1461164: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: room users can change the app language
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android will allow users to temporarily change the app language per session from the console, aligning with Windows experience. This feature rolls out from June to October 2026 with app version 2.12.0+, resets after restart, requires no admin action, and does not affect system settings.

item.title: RM392838: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Introduction of secure workflow to bypass legal holds and retention policies
item.description: The first release of Priority cleanup enables admins to create a recurring exception to delete items under a broader retention policy and/or legal hold on Exchange workload. Creating a Priority cleanup will require a separate security role, multiple approvers, and will have a complete audit trail.

item.title: RM570845: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. item.title: RM557560: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI Generated video drafts include text animations and new layout options
item.description: Users will find updated layouts and text animations on video projects generated with Copilot.

item.title: RM570668: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
item.description: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.

item.title: RM570842: Dynamics 365 Finance: Support requirements of tax reform in Brazil in 2027

Additional capabilities will continue to be introduced as future phases of Brazil's tax reform are implemented.

item.title: MC1466762: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
item.description: SharePoint News can now be cross-posted to Viva Engage communities with full fidelity and unified conversations across feeds, Outlook, Teams, and apps. Rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, this feature synchronizes comments and reactions, enhancing content reach without extra effort. Admins should inform users accordingly.

item.title: MC1469329: Build apps in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork
item.description: Microsoft announces a preview of app-building in Copilot Cowork starting September 8, 2026, with Copilot Studio following soon. Users with licenses can create, test, and publish apps using natural language and organizational data, governed by existing policies and managed via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1466328: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Desktop)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot's "Explain this presentation" skill, rolling out in September 2026 for Windows desktop, provides users with an impartial summary of presentations, including main ideas, key takeaways, numbers, visuals, speaker notes, and open questions, enhancing understanding without requiring user action.

item.title: MC1467357: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will feature a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard for chats and channels, improving navigation and access to key details. Rolling out from late September to early October 2026, this update aligns mobile with desktop experience and requires no user action.

item.description: Microsoft Edge will retire Manifest V2 (MV2) extensions by early 2027, fully switching to Manifest V3 (MV3) for improved security and performance. item.title: MC1467355: Power BI subscriptions: Changes to notification delivery and sender experience
item.description: Power BI is updating subscription notification delivery to improve reliability and sender reputation, changing sender identity, email formatting, and Copilot summary presentation. The phased rollout starts late September 2026 through January 2027. No subscription recreation is needed, but organizations should review mail rules relying on the old sender identity.

item.title: RM569209: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
item.description: You will now be able to add multiple steps to your workflow when building one from scratch.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will provide additional protection for QR codes shared by external users in messages. This helps reduce the risk of phishing and fraud by encouraging more deliberate interaction with QR code content.

item.title: RM567461: Microsoft Teams: Updated header and dashboard for chats and channels on mobile
item.description: You can now get oriented and take action faster when using Teams on mobile, with a redesigned header and lightweight dashboard that brings key channel details, people, and pinned content into one intuitive place. It creates a more predictable, familiar experience across desktop and mobile so you can move faster with less friction.

item.title: RM566316: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

item.title: RM564968: Microsoft Clipchamp: New text and shape animations in the video editor
item.description: Clipchamp Editor will support simple animations for text layers. Users can apply preset in/out animations, adjust how long the animation lasts, choose its direction, and preview the animated text in the editor prior to exporting. This capability will be available across web and native desktop versions of Clipchamp.

item.title: RM561033: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention – Device Health Reporting Dashboard
item.description: This dashboard will allow admins to view the device health across all their devices to ensure the system is healthy and ready to receive policy updates and quickly identify devices that are not ready.

item.title: RM558928: Planner: Microsoft Planner tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

item.title: RM553215: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Create Videos in the Clipchamp Start Page
item.description: Users can use Copilot to create videos directly from the Clipchamp Start page. Turn a simple prompt or existing document into a polished video in minutes. Copilot will automatically draft a script, selects visuals, add narration, and assembles the video for you—no video editing experience required. Review, refine, and export your video quickly, all in one flow.

item.title: RM566317: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
item.description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

item.title: MC1440968: Microsoft Entra ID: Optimizations for passkey registration experience
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID is optimizing passkey registration to better align with administrator policies, prioritize local device passkeys, and improve successful registrations without UI changes. The rollout begins late August 2026, completing by mid-September. No action is required; organizations should continue promoting passkey adoption.

item.title: MC1387814: Microsoft Teams: RTMP-In port and domain changes required
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating RTMP-In port and domain requirements to improve streaming reliability. Admins must allow outbound access to ports 50118, 50119, and domain *.rtmpingest.mcr.teams.cloud.microsoft by January 31, 2027. Existing RTMP-In events work until end of 2026; new events require updates to avoid failure.

item.title: MC1403410: Microsoft Viva: Agent flexible query in Analytics Workbench
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights Analytics Workbench will add a flexible query feature in late September 2026, enabling analysts to explore Microsoft 365 Copilot agent usage with customizable queries. This automatic update requires no admin action and supports data-driven decisions for organizations with over 50 Copilot licenses.

item.title: MC1466864: Call Quality Dashboard Custom Detailed Reports
item.description: Call Quality Dashboard will get a refreshed interface with enhanced accessibility and features like dark mode. Public preview starts mid-August 2026; general availability begins early September 2026. No action is needed, and users can revert to the old experience during rollout.

item.title: MC1466760: Microsoft Copilot Pages: Access existing Pages from the "/" menu in chat
item.description: Starting late August 2026, users can access existing Pages via the "/" menu in Copilot chat, while the "Edit in Pages" menu will focus on creating new Pages. This update streamlines referencing Pages without affecting existing content or permissions. No action is required.

item.title: MC1466757: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with List Form in Workflows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will add a new trigger, "A form is submitted," for automating actions based on SharePoint list–backed form responses. Rolling out September–October 2026, it enables posting responses in Teams, uses existing SharePoint governance, requires no admin action, and respects current permissions and policies.

item.title: MC1466754: Microsoft Viva Engage: Reducing reply notification volume in email
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will reduce email reply notifications by only sending alerts for direct replies, @mentions, and new posts, cutting down on broader conversation notifications. This change, rolling out from September to October 2026, requires no user action and keeps existing settings unchanged.

item.title: MC1466750: Microsoft Secure Score: New AI-readiness recommendations for device security
item.description: Microsoft Secure Score will add four new AI-readiness recommendations for device security in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, focusing on TPM 2.0, VBS, HVCI, and LAPS. These will help identify and remediate devices lacking key protections, rolling out from early to late September 2026 with no action required to receive them.

item.title: RM570468: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
item.description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

item.title: RM570443: Microsoft Edge: Tab organization enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Edge is expanding tab and Workspace organization capabilities to suggest groupings, names, visuals, and labels. Users can manage these experiences through the proposed “Let Microsoft Edge help keep your tabs organized” setting under Privacy, search, and services > Search and connected experiences; administrators can control them using the TabServicesEnabled policy.

item.title: RM506749: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
item.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM516043: Microsoft Edge: PDF Viewer Performance Improvement and Minor Visual Updates
item.description: The PDF Viewer in Microsoft Edge is migrating to WebUI2, enhancing responsiveness and introducing a series of subtle visual upgrades aimed at improving overall usability and utility. This migration ensures UI coherence with the rest of the browser while maintaining the same user experience.

item.title: RM561327: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: This feature is bringing the Information Protection Filer Labeler and Viewer applications to the MacOS platform. Enabling customers to have the same capabilities available on Mac. Core functionality will be available with the exception of the Advanced label-based protection feature.

item.title: RM568366: Microsoft Edge: Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
item.description: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions/notifications.

item.title: RM570467: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
item.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

item.title: RM570445: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

item.title: MC1166852: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics launches new agent dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics introduces a new Agent Dashboard for tracking agent adoption and Copilot credit usage, rolling out publicly in early February 2026 and generally available by late October 2026. It offers detailed metrics, retention trends, and top agent insights, enhancing the Copilot Dashboard's Adoption tab.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to use data masking to protect customer data in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. item.description: PowerPoint for the web will roll out an "Explain this presentation" skill in September 2026, providing users with an impartial summary of slides, charts, notes, key takeaways, numbers, visuals, and open questions to help understand presentations faster. item.title: MC1466326: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Mac)

item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection is introducing File Labeler and File Viewer apps for macOS, enabling sensitivity labeling and protected file viewing like on Windows. Public preview starts May 29, 2026, with general availability on November 30, 2026. Advanced label-based protection is not supported initially.

item.title: MC1466307: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce centralized channel notification settings, allowing users to manage all channel notifications from one location. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide in October 2026, preserves existing settings, requires no admin action, and aims to simplify notification management.

item.description: Project Online Essentials will reach end of life on October 1, 2026. Organizations must transition users to supported licenses like Project and Planner Plan 1 or Plan 3 before then to maintain access and licensing rights for Project Online, Project Server, and Planner Premium capabilities.

item.title: MC1466299: Microsoft Planner: New Planner usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center
item.description: A new Planner usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center, launching September 2026, provides admins with tenant-level and user-level Planner activity data, including active users and usage trends for basic and premium plans. It includes identifiable user info, requires no action, and supports compliance and reporting needs.

item.title: MC1466296: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a concern" feature in meetings by late 2026, allowing users to report suspicious behavior like phishing or scams. Reports, including meeting metadata, will be accessible to administrators via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center for investigation and response. This feature is enabled by default.

item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will provide native Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) controls for connected cameras that support this capability, whether the camera moves a physical lens or adjusts the image digitally. item.description: Admins now have a one-stop portal for inventory, health monitoring, management, and analytics for both Windows and Android devices with the Pro Management portal. Management of all Android Teams rooms, panels, and phone devices are transitioning to this portal from the Teams admin center, enabling easy, consistent, and secure management of Teams devices across all operating systems and manufacturers.

item.description: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. item.title: RM558852: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
item.description: Digital signage can now be displayed on idle Teams panel devices, similar to digital signage support for Microsoft Teams Rooms front of room displays. Signage source and settings can be configured in the Pro Management portal. Available with Teams Rooms Pro or Shared space-licensed spaces.

item.description: Microsoft is announcing the General Availability (GA) of federated Copilot connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Copilot to popular third‑party sources and retrieve data in real time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). item.title: RM559608: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items from unread-only view
item.description: Teams chat and channel lists can be filtered to show unread items only. When this filter is applied, hovering over a section reveals an eye icon next to the section name. Selecting the eye icon opens a list of read chats or channels within that section, allowing you to open them without leaving the unread-only view.

item.title: RM559617: Microsoft Purview: Purview in Microsoft Admin Center
item.description: AI and IT admins in Microsoft Admin Center can 1) gain visibility around oversharing risks and drive remediations 2) Understand how much of sensitive copilot interactions are protected and turn on Purview DLP for M365 Copilot right from there. Enables secure adoption of Copilot. Updated September 1, 2026: We are not moving forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.description: We are updating the default profanity filter setting for live captions from On to Off across Teams meetings, calls, events, and Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) devices to improve accessibility and align with EU requirements. This change will only affect users who have never configured their live captions profanity filter preference. Users who have already set their preference will keep their current setting. item.title: RM558679: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files
item.description: Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft Excel files now open in a standardized preview in Teams on Android and iOS, delivering faster performance, improved reliability, and a more consistent viewing experience.

item.title: RM560820: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
item.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

item.title: RM569214: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
item.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

item.description: When a user performs a search on google.com from a work profile, Microsoft Edge can detect whether organization-specific results are available for that query. When relevant results are found, a banner is shown with a link to explore those work results with Microsoft 365 Copilot. This builds on the existing experience already available on Bing and extends it to Google, helping users seamlessly access work-related information regardless of their search engine. item.description: Out-of-box MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA Alert Reporting dashboard showing past trends, Top SITs getting exposed via DLP alerts generated. Customers can define their custom SLAs for high, med and low severity alerts and get access to dashboard showing operational performance and SLA metrics.

item.title: RM564912: Microsoft Teams: New room optimization mode user experience in Teams desktop
item.description: Users can more easily use their laptop for meetings and collaboration in spaces like focus or huddle rooms that don’t yet have a Teams Rooms system. The new room optimization mode replaces shared display mode, has a new location, and enables or disables room-specific features. When room peripherals are connected, Teams can automatically select audio and video devices, enable speaker recognition and shared display, and disable voice isolation.

item.title: RM565215: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
item.description: Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. Admins configure the feature per queue via Teams admin center or PowerShell, with controls for recording, transcription and agent access to recordings. Recordings are stored in SharePoint and available through the Queues app call history. Note: Queues app requires a Teams Premium license.

item.title: RM564614: Microsoft Teams: Meeting recap app
item.description: The meeting recap app brings all your meeting recaps into one place, making it easier to find, filter, and catch up. Quick filters help you surface the right meetings instantly, while audio recap lets you efficiently review multiple meetings at once. You can also browse and revisit any recap from the past 30 days.

item.title: RM569609: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
item.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.

item.title: RM564617: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Rights Management connector – Certificate-based authentication
item.description: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is moving from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving its security posture. With this update, administrators configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use the new PowerShell module to configure the certificate for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI). item.title: RM565131: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
item.description: Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines.

item.title: RM562050: Microsoft Teams: Support human interpreter listening mode in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows now supports human interpreter listening mode in meetings where organizers enable language interpretation in Meeting options, allowing room participants to select a language and hear interpreter audio.

item.title: RM561604: Microsoft Teams: Chat panel open by default in the gallery view on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join. Admins can configure this default device behavior, and users can close the panel in one tap during meetings.

item.title: MC1459138: Microsoft Teams: Local Pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will add native local Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera controls for compatible cameras, allowing users to adjust cameras directly from the room console. item.title: MC1307982: Microsoft Teams Town halls: Upload custom backgrounds in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers and presenters of town hall events with Teams Premium licenses to upload custom background images in the "Manage what attendees see" feature. This rollout begins early June 2026, enhancing branded visuals behind presenters and shared content in supported layouts.

item.title: MC1250273: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve copy-paste support for @mentions and shared contacts by preserving interactive tags when valid in the destination. If invalid, tags revert to plain text with original display. Rollout occurs May to mid-September 2026 across platforms, requiring no admin action and enhancing messaging consistency.

item.title: MC1197146: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams enables quick voice profile registration for enhanced features like speaker recognition and improved transcripts. Rolling out mid-June to mid-September 2026 for commercial tenants (excluding EDU), it is ON by default but can be managed or disabled by admins via PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1459131: Microsoft Teams: Prepare custom apps for private and shared channel compatibility
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a feature by mid-September 2026 to help admins identify custom line-of-business apps needing updates for private and shared channel compatibility. Updating these apps ensures business continuity, reduces support issues, and maintains app access across evolving channel experiences.

item.title: MC1454108: Microsoft 365 Copilot app update: Simpler Copilot access
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app is updating to a unified app for personal and work accounts with clearer visual cues, a simpler name and icon, and a new web URL (copilot.cloud.microsoft). Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to security, compliance, or enterprise controls.

item.title: MC1455013: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. item.title: MC1281505: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes via PowerShell. item.title: MC1422060: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Prompt injection protection for email
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will introduce prompt injection protection for email, detecting and quarantining malicious content targeting AI assistants.
